problem_claim.quote: Students often struggle with large amounts of study material and limited time.

value_proposition.quote: My app solves this by breaking content into short summaries, flashcards, and quizzes that improve understanding and memory.

evidence_claims.claim: Mobile learning app with three core features
evidence_claims.quote: my venture is a mobile learning app that helps students to study faster using short summaries and quizzes

evidence_claims.claim: Prototype includes mobile interface with summaries, flashcards, and quizzes
evidence_claims.quote: The prototype would include a simple mobile interface with three main features: summaries, flashcards, and short quizzes after each topic.

evidence_claims.claim: Risk: low user engagement; mitigation: gamification with points and tracking
evidence_claims.quote: One risk is low user engagement, which I would solve by adding gamification like points and progressive tracking.

evidence_claims.claim: Risk: inaccurate content; mitigation: validation with experts or trusted sources
evidence_claims.quote: Another risk is inaccurate content, which would be handled by vali- validating materials with experts or trusted sources.

evidence_claims.claim: Critical tasks: data collection, content creation, app development, testing
evidence_claims.quote: The most surprising-- important tasks are data collection, content creation, app development, and testing.
the project would take around ten to twelve weeks

evidence_claims.claim: Critical path sequence: idea, content, development, testing, launch
evidence_claims.quote: The critical path is, uh, idea, content, development, testing, and launch.

evidence_claims.claim: Team composition: software developer, UX/UI designer, content creator
evidence_claims.quote: The initial team would include a software developer, a UX/UI designer, and a content creator.

evidence_claims.claim: Goal: make learning simpler, faster, and more effective for students
evidence_claims.quote: The goal is to make learning simpler, faster, and more effective for students.

evidence_claims.claim: Design principle: easy and fast to use
evidence_claims.quote: It will be designed to be very easy and fast to use.
